name: Tyler Perry's For Better or Worse
description: Follow the ups-and-downs of Angela Williams, the owner of a successful beauty salon, and her husband of 13 years, Marcus, a former professional football player who has recently partnered with Richard Ellington and Joseph Jetson on a new sports news program called "C-Sports Now."

videos.title: A Better Me
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Dominique, Marcus' daughter, calls her stepmother, Angela, a whore in front of the couple's son M.J., Angela is sure that Dominique picked up such language from her mother, Keisha. When Keisha shows up to Angela's house, the confrontation turns into a knock down drag out fight.

videos.title: One Last Try
videos.overview: Tensions run high at a dinner party hosted by Joseph and Leslie; Leslie witnesses a part of "an exchange" between Marcus and Keisha.

videos.title: The One I Want
videos.overview: Leslie battles with whether or not she should tell Angela what she saw between Marcus and Keisha and confides in Jennifer. Marcus is uncomfortable with the fact that Angela and Keisha are becoming friends.

videos.title: Deceiving Eyes
videos.overview: A secret centering on Marcus and Keisha makes waves at a pool party.

videos.title: Forsaking All Others
videos.overview: Angela receives an unexpected and potentially life-changing letter in the mail.

videos.title: To Lie Or Not To Lie
videos.overview: In the aftermath of receiving a letter from the mysterious Sabrina Murphy, Angela tries to deal with her emotions; Marcus tries to help her.

videos.title: For Baby Mama Drama
videos.overview: Domestic issues affect Marcus' job performance. Meanwhile, a disgusted Angela takes her frustrations out on Marcus' personal property.

videos.title: Speak Now
videos.overview: Angela move ahead with the expansion of her salon in the midst of Marcus' alleged infidelity. She meets Tyrik, a contractor, who says they shared an intimate past, but Angela does not recall the exchange.

videos.title: For Richer Or Poorer
videos.overview: Marcus and Angela continue to clash over lies and infidelity. The tension pushes Marcus to make large purchases, but the money he uses becomes an issue.

videos.title: To Believe or Not To Believe
videos.overview: A feuding Marcus and Angela are forced to explain all their issues to their son.

videos.title: You Are The Father
videos.overview: Haunted by a one night stand she had fourteen years ago, Angela is horrified when Tyrik's mother has an uncanny resemblance to M.J. sparking drastic steps to be taken for DNA samples; At C-Sports, the guys are frustrated by Keisha's incessant presence at the studio.

videos.title: Biological Clock
videos.overview: On her birthday, Leslie freaks out about getting older.

videos.title: Tommy
videos.overview: Jennifer discovers her son, Tommy, wearing her make-up and heels. She fears he might be gay. In an attempt to counteract his behavior, she pleads with Marcus and Joseph to spend time with him.

videos.title: Just the Two of Us Part 1
Just the Two of Us Part 2
Off the Hook
videos.overview: Keisha stops Marcus' child support payments due to recent events; Despite Marcus telling her to let it go, Angela is suspicious.

videos.title: You Should've Put a Ring On It
Leslie Christian
videos.overview: Joseph has a meltdown after a phone call from a woman; Chris decides that he and Leslie need time apart.

videos.title: Joseph
videos.overview: Leslie is distressed when she returns from her honeymoon, having called Chris by Joseph's name.

videos.title: Back Down Memory Lane
videos.overview: Angela tries to play a memory game with Marcus.

videos.title: The Stalker
videos.overview: Using one of her old calendars, Joseph begins to stalk Leslie.

videos.title: House for Sale
videos.overview: Leslie prepares to show a house to a potential client, only to learn the client is Joseph.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: Leslie tells Angela and Jennifer that she kissed Joseph.

videos.title: Maybe We Made a Mistake
videos.overview: When Chris invites Leslie over for dinner to 'talk', Leslie thinks he wants their marriage annulled.

videos.title: Annulled
videos.overview: Leslie spots Keisha plotting with a divorce attorney when she officially annuls her marriage.

videos.title: The Beauty Pageant
videos.overview: In an effort to help distract Joseph, Todd starts a Miss C-Sports Now pageant.

videos.title: Trouble in Paradise
videos.overview: Keisha tells Angela that the guys have a bevy of women at C-Sports Now in hopes that Angela will shut down the pageant.

videos.title: Move the Money
videos.overview: The guys move their accounts to another bank so Keisha won't have access to C-Sports finances.

videos.title: You're Under Arrest
videos.overview: Keisha feigns an attack on herself and has Marcus, Joseph, Richard and Todd incarcerated.

videos.title: You're Under Arrest
videos.overview: The guys appear to be missing; Angela, Leslie and Jennifer find them at the police station.

videos.title: Stay Out of It
videos.overview: Marcus tells Angela to stay out of Keisha's business; Angela meets with Keisha anyway.

videos.title: The Exam
videos.overview: The guys endure colonoscopies and prostate exams to maintain their healthcare coverage.

videos.title: Keisha's Up to Something
videos.overview: In spite, Keisha tells Joseph that Leslie's marriage is annulled.

videos.title: The Unknown Caller
videos.overview: Leslie is exasperated by an unknown caller.

videos.title: The Automatic Teller Machine
videos.overview: Keisha meets a man named Eric while trapped inside an ATM room.

videos.title: The Automatic Teller Machine
videos.overview: Keisha and her new friend are caught.

videos.title: A Woman Scorned
videos.overview: The ladies look back at past relationships; the guys try to talk Richard into walking away from Keisha.

videos.title: Sleep Talking
videos.overview: Marcus is caught talking about another woman in his sleep.

videos.title: Stalked: Part 1
videos.overview: Joseph worries that Leslie's life is in danger.

videos.title: Stalked: Part 2
videos.overview: Joseph saves Leslie.

videos.title: Too Much Sex
videos.overview: Marcus overwhelms Angela when his sex drive rivals that of his college days. Meanwhile at C-Sports Joseph, Todd and Richard search for missing fertility pills for Leslie's dog, Fifi.

videos.title: Shawn - Part 1
videos.overview: A pregnant woman named Shawn claims that Marcus is the father of her unborn child.

videos.title: Shawn - Part 2
videos.overview: Todd makes a shocking discovery about Shawn, much to Marcus' relief.

videos.title: The Divorce Papers
videos.overview: Keisha moves out of the house after serving Richard with divorce papers.

videos.title: It's My House
videos.overview: Richard does all that he can to ensure Keisha does not take everything that belongs to him.

videos.title: The Restraining Order
videos.overview: Keisha retaliates against Richard's recent actions by filing a restraining order.

videos.title: Please Say Yes
videos.overview: Joseph tries to come up with proposal ideas for Leslie, but finds himself struggling.

videos.title: I Want Half
videos.overview: The guys at the studio fear that Richard has put himself in a precarious position.

videos.title: The Big Secret
videos.overview: Marcus and Angela worry about having another child at this point in their lives. Meanwhile Leslie and Jennifer have a big secret to tell their men.

videos.title: Bodacious
videos.overview: They guys are all at odds with their women. They are able to trace their marital woes back to a stripper named Bodacious.

videos.title: And It Starts
videos.overview: The women are very irritable as their husbands try to cope.

videos.title: All Over the Place
videos.overview: Jennifer needs convincing to receive prenatal care.

videos.title: Faking It
videos.overview: The ladies reveal the results of their second home pregnancy tests.

videos.title: I Got Her Card
videos.overview: Jennifer decides to take Richard's legal trouble into her own hands. With the help of a private investigator, Jennifer spoils Keisha's diabolical scheme.

videos.title: I Have Lived
videos.overview: Marcus' ex-teammate shows up at C-Sports Now. The former athlete is in desperate need of a friend.

videos.title: All the Voices
videos.overview: The guys come to the rescue of William, Marcus' old teammate.

videos.title: When the Lights Go Out
videos.overview: After the death of a friend, Marcus and the gang try to cope. In the meantime another friend from the past shows up at Marcus' doorstep.

videos.title: The Misty Vine Hotel
videos.overview: Benny lets Angela know that he is interested in reigniting the flame they once shared. Angela is confident she can resist, until Marcus makes it more difficult.

videos.title: To Tell or Not To Tell
videos.overview: Angela laments over her decision to let Benny stay at the house. She has to decide whether or not to tell Marcus her secret.

videos.title: The Alarm
videos.overview: Angela is restless because of her new house-guest.

videos.title: Just Happened
videos.overview: Angela is forced to explain herself, as Marcus questions the strength of Angela's commitment to him.

videos.title: The Way He Looks at Me
videos.overview: Angela and Marcus' bond is tested.

videos.title: Just A Kiss
videos.overview: The guys attempt to convince Marcus to give Angela a pass.

videos.title: The Silverback
videos.overview: Marcus tries to make Angela jealous.

videos.title: Make Him Call Your Name
videos.overview: As Angela plans to meet up with Benny, the gang tries to persuade her not to go.
